lines.text: Zendesk lists 1,800+ apps, partners and integrations in its Marketplace, against Freshdesk's 1,200 other business apps. Zendesk has the larger count.

lines.text: Zendesk was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for the CRM Customer Engagement Center. Freshdesk's facts include no comparable analyst recognition.
lines.reason: the reader: that Freshdesk has no comparable analyst recognition

lines.text: Zendesk claims its AI Agents can achieve up to 80% automation. This is a vendor claim, but it is a strong headline.
lines.reason: it says more than its facts do

lines.text: Zendesk has built-in QA scoring for 100% of AI interactions.
Zendesk handles email, chat, phone, social, messaging apps and help center in one interface.
Zendesk gives qualified startups up to 2 years free, and its 14-day trial needs no credit card.
Freshdesk publishes plan pricing: Growth $19, Pro $55 and Enterprise $89 per agent per month, billed annually.
The Freddy AI Agent is included on all three Freshdesk plans with 500 free sessions, limited to once per account. Extra sessions cost $49 per 100, so AI cost is predictable.
lines.reason: the reader: that AI cost is predictable

lines.text: The Freshdesk 14-day trial gives instant access to the Enterprise plan, and there is a free signup for those without an account.
Freshdesk Pro and above has multiple SLA policies for different customers, products or priorities. Parent-child tickets split complex issues into linked tasks that different agents work on at once.
Freshdesk has built-in dashboards and report templates on every plan, with custom dashboards on Pro and above. Freddy AI Insights on Enterprise runs root cause analysis for leaders.
Thomas Cook saw unresolved tickets drop 37% while total tickets handled rose 55%.
Freshdesk is built for growing service teams, typically businesses of 50 to 500 employees.
How many AI conversations a month do you expect? The first 500 Freshdesk sessions are free, once per account, and each extra 100 costs $49.
Do you need different SLA policies for different customers, products or priorities?
Do complex issues need several agents working at once on linked tasks?
Which apps must your helpdesk connect to, and are they among Freshdesk's integrations?
How much does measuring and checking AI quality matter to you? Zendesk offers QA scoring on 100% of AI interactions.

It does list more, 1,800+ against our 1,200. Freshdesk covers Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Shopify and Mailchimp, and has Technology Partners building more. Let's check the specific tools you use.
lines.objection: Zendesk has more apps and integrations.

lines.text: That is a real recognition for them. I'd suggest judging on your own needs, and you can test Freshdesk's Enterprise plan free for 14 days.
That's their claim. With Freshdesk the Freddy AI Agent is on every plan with 500 free sessions, so you can test it on your own tickets. Extra sessions are $49 per 100.

lines.text: Fair. Freshdesk's 14-day trial gives instant Enterprise access, and there is a free signup.
